title: A point of an open after base change has a descended compact neighborhood
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $X$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and $A$ a commutative $k$-algebra. Set $X_A=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-pc-base-change], using the algebra structure map on spectra [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For any open $V\subseteq X_A$ and any point $x\in V$, there exist a finitely generated $k$-subalgebra $B\subseteq A$ and a quasi-compact open $W\subseteq X_B$ such that $x\in\pi_B^{-1}(W)\subseteq V$, where $X_B=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}B$ and $\pi_B=\mathrm{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(B\hookrightarrow A)$. No quasi-compactness of $V$, separatedness or quasi-separatedness of $X$ is assumed.

proof.text: Choose an affine open U = Spec R of X containing the image of x. Its base change U_A is an open subscheme of X_A by [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product], identified with Spec(R tensor_k A) by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. The principal-open basis gives t in R tensor_k A such that x belongs to D(t) and D(t) is contained in V intersect U_A.

Write t as a finite sum of pure tensors. Let B be the k-subalgebra of A generated by their A-coefficients. It is finitely generated, and the same finite sum with coefficients in B constructs a tensor t′ mapping to t. This also covers the zero tensor and empty coefficient set.

In U_B = Spec(R tensor_k B), take D(t′), and let W be its image in X_B under the open immersion [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product]. This image is open and compact, since principal opens of affine schemes are affine and compact. The tensor-spectrum identifications [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identify the canonical projection on the chart with Spec of the coefficient-inclusion tensor map. Its inverse image of D(t′) is D(t). Consequently x belongs to the inverse image of W, and that inverse image is contained in V.

proof_origin.place: Pointwise reformulation of the single-principal-open finite-coefficient argument in proof of Tag 0388; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0388.

lean.statement: theorem exists_descended_qc_neighborhood (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (V : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))).Opens) (x : ↥(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))))) (hx : x ∈ V) : ∃ (B : Subalgebra k A), B.FG ∧ ∃ (W : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))).Opens), IsCompact W.1 ∧ let π := baseChangeMap f (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.val B))) (by change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Subalgebra.val B)) ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) rw [← Spec.map_comp] congr 1) : Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))) ⟶ Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B)))) x ∈ π ⁻¹ᵁ W ∧ π ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ V
